owned_interfaces.physical: ReceivePlan + ReceiveTransfer produce canonical sd_controller::Request values and retain a borrow until the closed host pump returns its physical receipt.
owned_interfaces.completion: PendingCommands registers the actual transmitted header and typed owner, correlates parsed device response sequences, and returns a private-construction completion. Cancellation removes exactly one owner; teardown removes all owners eagerly.
owned_interfaces.gate: OwnershipGate emits canonical register requests, source-bound delays and an owned terminal result.
owned_interfaces.interrupt: SnapshotRead emits the actual physical88-byte request and typed ordered CPU actions. InterruptControl emits source-bound disable/restore register requests.
owned_interfaces.consumers: Nested events and reorder engines and canonical association/secondary/adapter consumers own the event-specific continuations. No firmware code pointer crosses the boundary.
